name: Julian Nubert
tagline: Robotics researcher and founder, building perception for humanoid robots.
about: I'm a founder of Flexion Robotics, where I lead the perception team. At Flexion we are building the autonomy stack for humanoid robots. It covers perception, locomotion, manipulation and task-level reasoning, uses simulation and reinforcement learning, and is designed to transfer to real-world hardware.

Before Flexion, I did my PhD at ETH Zurich in the Robotic Systems Lab with Marco Hutter, as part of the Max Planck ETH Center for Learning Systems with Katherine J. Kuchenbecker (Haptic Intelligence, MPI for Intelligent Systems). During my PhD I also worked with the NASA Jet Propulsion Laboratory. My thesis focused on robust and flexible robot state and motion estimation through optimization and learning: LiDAR odometry, localizability-aware registration, and multi-sensor factor-graph fusion for robots operating in extreme environments.

flexion.summary: Flexion builds the robots' brain: a hardware-agnostic autonomy stack that takes humanoids from simulation to real-world tasks.
